# SCNet Token Plan

Use `scnet-token-plan/<model>` with VoltAgent's model router.

## Quick start

```ts
import { Agent } from "@voltagent/core";

const agent = new Agent({
  name: "scnet-token-plan-agent",
  instructions: "You are a helpful assistant",
  model: "scnet-token-plan/DeepSeek-V4-Flash",
});
```

## Environment variables

- `SCNET_API_KEY`

## Provider package

`@ai-sdk/openai-compatible`

This provider uses the OpenAI-compatible adapter.

## Default base URL

`https://api.scnet.cn/api/llm/v1`

You can override the base URL by setting `SCNET_TOKEN_PLAN_BASE_URL`.

- https://www.scnet.cn/ac/openapi/doc/2.0/moduleapi/plans/token-plan.html
